title: Raspberry Ripple Mousse
description: A light, tropical coconut cream mousse with fresh raspberries swirled through in a ripple effect, set with gelatine.
steps: Whisk the chilled coconut cream until smooth and frothy. Refrigerate.
Heat most of the raspberries in a saucepan until the juice bubbles. Mash through a sieve to make a smooth coulis.
Dissolve the gelatine sachet in hot water per packet instructions. Add 40ml of the mixture to the coconut cream and whisk.
Transfer the mousse to a large serving bowl (or ramekins). Refrigerate for 30 minutes until slightly firmer.
Swirl spoonfuls of raspberry coulis through the mousse gently for a visible ripple. Scatter sliced remaining raspberries on top.
Refrigerate for at least 2 more hours before serving.
notes: Serves 4. Plan ahead — the coconut cream must be chilled overnight. Pairs well with chopped chocolate sprinkled on top.
